name: RetryBudget
purpose: Sliding-window retry budget: caps the ratio of retries to total requests over a rolling time window so a failing downstream cannot be DDoS'd by the caller's own retry loop. Enforces only after a warm-up threshold (`min_requests`) to avoid false positives on cold starts.
api_signature: class RetryBudget: record_request(...), record_retry(...), can_retry(...), current_ratio(...), stats(...)
invariants: RETRY_BUDGET_INV_01: `can_retry()` MUST return True when total requests in the window is below `min_requests` (warm-up bypass).
RETRY_BUDGET_INV_02: After warm-up, `can_retry()` MUST return False iff `len(_retries) / len(_requests) > ratio` over the current window.
RETRY_BUDGET_INV_03: Samples older than `window_s` MUST be evicted on every record/check, so the decision is always based on the CURRENT rolling window.
